listBibl.head: Derived from CDSL source records for the TEI Lex-0 baseline pilot.

projectDesc.p: tei-lex0-pilot-v0.1; DARIAH TEI Lex-0 baseline element model. Per-statement epistemic status is carried in @cert/@resp (docs/EVIDENCE_LABEL_CROSSWALK.md).

sense.note: Sense and its closing authority (iti Kavikalpadruma) are one indivisible iti-unit in the source, split into def + bibl in the Lex-0 baseline.

entry.note: Empty anubandha slot: per the Śabdakalpadruma front matter a root without anubandha carries a dot or zero here — the source's statement 'no anubandha', not missing data.
Pada not asserted: SKD marks only ātmanepada (ṅ) and ubhayapada (ñ); parasmaipada is the unmarked default (Dhātudīpikā key), so no pada is encoded rather than a default over-asserted.
Gaṇa not resolved by the M4 decode: an unresolved gaṇa is a detector limit, not a statement that the root has none.
iti-unit: sense and closing authority fused
Zero-meaning: a marker's absence is itself a statement
Source-parsed indigenous kosa entry: meanings/synonyms are grouped by their closing authority (iti <author>), the kosa's own sense-and-citation unit.
